scope: Nine failed assertions: foreign and other-template prerequisites, non-atomic/missing audits, obsolete revision and three malformed graphs. Not nine independent vulnerabilities. Mutations read actual SQL state after the call; no refusal caused only by an absent version token.

initialHarnessFailure.scope: Same nine product assertions failed; afterAll additionally attempted to delete the company before its restricted client. Cleanup order fixed, no production code changed, then rerun on a new database. The cleanup failure is not a tenth product defect.
